q1_issues.issue: The "as a trickle" phase-state is emitted as a flat, tenseless (Member sk_freedom_movement_1 trickle), so the KB asserts the movement simply is a trickle — unbounded in time, un-linked to the start event, and missing the Past wrapper a past copular state takes.
"turned into a gusher" is a change of kind, not motion, so the spatial Goal oblique (reserved for "into / onto / to" paths) misreads the construction.
A separate witness sk_gusher_1 is minted for what the sentence says the movement itself became, so nothing in the parse records the identity of the movement with the gusher.

q2_gaps: "V as NP" predicative complement ("started as a trickle", "worked as a clerk") — no rule assigns a phase/capacity predicative, and "as" is not one of the preposition-named-oblique cases
change-of-kind / becoming ("turned into a gusher", "became a gusher") — no operator lets one entity come to be of a new kind, so source and result cannot be identified
live metaphor: a non-literal kind predication of an abstract referent (a movement as a trickle / gusher) is asserted literally, and the idiom coherence test only covers fixed idioms
notes: The compound handling is right — genus (Inheritance freedom_movement movement) with the noun modifier "freedom" correctly left unexposed — and the coordinated VPs are translated independently over the shared subject as required.
